title: Normalized projective-line presentation and adjunction data
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E/Q_ell, and an arbitrary scheme S with ell invertible, using [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels], [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers], [det-sp-tower-classes], [def-sp-tower-class-twisting], [def-sp-tower-class-pullback], [def-sp-tower-class-diagonal]. Define the existing projective-line presentation interfaces SpTowerP1.Presentation, Maps and AdjunctionData and their helper definitions. The domain is the full ordinary derived bounded-below category with retained finite etale-origin witnesses. TensorData fixes the recorded tensor, signed symmetry and scalar unitors. Presentation fixes the actual positive Chern and diagonal classes, operations, section-normalized identity pullback and diagonal-line comparison. Maps records domain preservation and invertibility of the specified counit-transpose projection and proper exchange arrows. The explicit epsilon is the inverse projection, symmetry, tensor with the splitting trace and scalar unitor; eta uses the supported diagonal class, inverse specified projection and proper exchange. AdjunctionData is an adjunction of the restricted functors whose unit and counit equal exactly these eta and epsilon arrows, with finite adjunction comparisons and constructible restrictions. All these are data interfaces and complete functor and arrow definitions; no assertion that such data exist is made.
